text: Alina - engaged!! Bogdan proposed Sat night @ Primrose Hill. wedding prob summer 2027. send congrats card
James - mum's hip op Thurs at 9am. he's v anxious abt it, she's 81. text him Thurs eve to see how it went

Saskia - band headlining @ the Lexington Fri 30 Oct, doors 8pm, on stage at half 9. 1st headline slot, she's bricking it - been sick w nerves at the last 2 gigs. her mum + dad driving down from Hull for it. her bf Gintaras doing merch. I said I'd go, bringing Amy. must text her good luck Fri afternoon, not right before
Patrick + Claire - 10 yr anniv 14 November 2026. booked the Italian place they had 1st date @
Mehmet - son in school nativity, Weds 9 Dec at 2pm. playing a sheep lol
Ana's brother Felix running Valencia marathon 6 December 2026. she's flying out the Fri before to watch
wedding's off. Jasmine + Ben split, end of Sept. she's at her sister's for now. check in w her next wk, maybe coffee
Gintaras - dog Bruno had knee op yest, home now / crate rest. kids v upset abt the cone
dry cleaning - pick up tmrw morning before 10. suit for Sat

Rahul - dad in hosp since Mon, chest pains. more tests tomorrow afternoon. call him Weds
Amy - mum turning 70 on 3 Jan. A says she'd love a kindle, current one's dying
Carlos (Carlitos) - son's 1st football tournament Sat 7 Nov, 10am kick off @ Hackney Marshes. C coaching the U9s too
Mustafa - wife's due 2 Feb 2027, their 2nd. morning sickness v bad still. he's knackered
Björn - got into the London Marathon ballot!! April 2027. training starts Jan. v smug
Tunde + Chidi - wedding 12 June 2027 in Lagos. save the date came today. need to look at flights before xmas
Bogdan - partner Dorota's play opens Thurs 5 Nov at 7.30, Arcola. he's got us 2 tix. I'm driving
Nina - sister Angela getting married next Sat in Brighton. N doing a reading + v nervous abt it
Gareth - darts final Fri night @ the Feathers. been practising every eve lol. ask him Sat how it went
Grace - boyf Duc's mum v unwell, back in Hanoi. he's flying out Tues morning, not sure for how long. G holding up ok-ish
Claire - anniv was yest, 5 yrs. Patrick forgot!! she's furious lol
Angela - grandson's christening Sun 15 Nov, 11am. she's knitting the shawl herself
Dr Kumar - appt moved to 4 Nov at 11.15. bring old prescriptions
Jasmine - now dating Gareth?? apparently since summer. both v loved up
Felix - violin grade 8 exam 17 Nov at half 9. been practising 3 hrs a day. remind me to wish him luck the night before

Ana - parents' 40th anniv party Sat 21 November 2026, 7pm, at their house in Croydon. A's doing a slideshow - wants old photos of her + her brother Felix by the 14th. her dad's not been great (heart stuff) so it's a smaller do than planned, family + close friends only. I'm bringing dessert. find the uni photos this wkend + send them over
Saskia - gig went really well apparently, label guy was there. follow up next wk re what he said
Lachlan - stag's cancelled, groom got cold feet?? not clear. wedding still on for now
Mei - loves Studio Ghibli, mentioned the Totoro stage show @ Barbican. gift idea for her bday
Patrick - eldest Ben ran the Royal Parks half last Sun, 1h52. P well proud. say congrats to Ben next time I see him
Duc - cat Miso missing since Fri night. posters up round Leyton. he's gutted
call council re bin collection - before Fri
Isabel - hates surprise parties, do NOT do one for her 40th
Eamon - wife Saskia had baby girl Tues 13 Oct at 4am!! 3.4kg, both doing fine. send flowers + card, prob this wk
James - running a 10k Sun morning for his mum's hospice. sponsor him

Suzanne - kids both in the school panto, 'Aladdin', Fri 11 Dec at 6pm + Sat matinee at 2. youngest is Abanazar (!), older one in the chorus + v annoyed abt it. S roped into making 14 costumes, totally stressed, sewing every eve till midnight. her husband useless apparently. offered to help w the hats next Tues eve
Gintaras + wife - 20 yrs married 1 Dec. going to Vilnius for the wk. G wants ideas for a ring
Rahul - cousin's wedding was last wkend, 3 days, 600 ppl. R still recovering lol. sister Amy got engaged at the reception!!

Chidi - chess tournament Sat 24 Oct, Manchester, 1st round at 10am. 1st rated event, nervous + not sleeping. his dad used to play for Nigeria apparently, so pressure. Tunde driving him up Fri evening. text him good luck Fri night + ask Sun how he did
Mehmet - mum moving in w them in Jan. bit tense at home. M working from home Mon-Weds
Nina - into pottery now, Tues eve class in Walthamstow. wants a wheel eventually
book MOT - due end of Nov

Tunde - long chat after church. his younger sister Jasmine's engaged to a guy from Leeds, wedding Easter 2027 but date not fixed. T not keen on him tbh. mum's v happy tho, already planning outfits. T also mentioned his boss is retiring 30 Nov - he might go for the role, interview prob early Dec. remind me to ask him about it end of Nov
Alina - engagement party 28 Nov at 8pm, Bogdan's parents' place. ask what to bring. also her mum's v unwell - ask after her
Björn - band's playing Jazz Café 4 March 2027. tix on sale Fri at 10am. remind me to get 2
Amy - dad retiring end of Dec after 38 yrs @ Royal Mail. family do on the 19th, lunchtime

Grace - nan's 90th Sat 31 Oct, afternoon tea at 3 @ the Langham. G making the cake, 3 tiers, stressed it'll collapse on the tube. nan still lives on her own in Margate, sharp as anything, does the crossword in pen. G's uncle Eamon flying in from Dublin the night before. don't forget card for nan
Carlos - lives in Walthamstow now, moved in Aug w girlfriend Isabel. near the market

Dorota - audition for the Old Vic panto Mon 2 Nov at 11am. 3rd time trying, last 2 she got to recall + then nothing. says she's fine but def not fine. also teaching drama at a primary in Hackney 3 days a wk to pay rent. need to text her that morning + ask Tues how it went
Ben - wedding date set!! 22 August 2027, Cornwall. Jasmine's not invited apparently - awkward

Gareth - lost the darts final Fri, 5-4 in the last leg, gutted. wife Mei says he's been sulking all wkend + hasn't touched the board since. she reckons a new set of darts wd cheer him up, his are 15 yrs old. take him for a pint this wk + maybe go halves w Mei on the darts
Claire - twins' swimming gala Sat at 9, Leyton baths. both in the 50m. C can't make it, working. ask Patrick after how they did

Lachlan (Lachie) - new guy at work, Aussie, from Perth. coeliac so no work pizza Fridays for him. huge AFL nerd, Collingwood. girlfriend Mei is a nurse at the Whittington. they're into climbing, go to the Castle most wkends. could invite them to the Xmas drinks
Felix - mum Suzanne had her knee done Fri 16 Oct, recovering slow. F doing the shopping for her
Angela - golden wedding 1 Jan 2027!! Dorota + Mehmet organising a do on the 2nd at 1pm. need to RSVP by 20 Nov
gym - 7am Mon/Weds/Fri from next wk, new routine

Mustafa - Galatasaray match Weds at 5.45, he's going w his uncle. long call tonight abt work stuff, he's thinking of leaving his job. check in w him mid next wk, don't push. also his wife's scan is 9 Nov, 10ish - ask after that
